title: Warmth for an egg
hook: Developing eggs exchange heat with their surroundings.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The arrow runs from the warmer bird toward the cooler egg in this contact model. Incubation conditions vary among species, and the drawing does not predict the egg’s exact temperature.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A bird settles over a cooler egg. In this simplified comparison, which way does heat move by contact?
